postureRows.meteredPolicy: Metered network is allowed only when the user has not enabled Wi-Fi-only rotation.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Settings diagnostics and support bundles read ConnectivityManager metered/Data Saver status and show action hints for restricted background data plus OEM battery recovery guidance.
postureRows.privacySurface: Remote wallpaper provider fetches already map through Data safety network endpoint rows.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No network is used; backups write only to the user-selected Storage Access Framework destination.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver does not affect local backup export; battery-not-low and destination access are the applicable gates.
postureRows.privacySurface: Backup content stays in the user-selected document tree and is never uploaded by this worker.

requiredSourceTerms: Bing Daily first, then Wallhaven toplist
postureRows.meteredPolicy: Metered network is currently allowed for the small daily Bing or Wallhaven metadata and thumbnail fetch.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Settings diagnostics and support bundles read ConnectivityManager metered/Data Saver status and show action hints for restricted background data plus OEM battery recovery guidance.
postureRows.privacySurface: Bing, Wallhaven, and notification behavior are covered by network endpoint and Data safety rows.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No network is used; restoration validates and reapplies persisted local content URIs.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver does not affect boot-time ringtone restoration because it performs no remote request.
postureRows.privacySurface: Only local ringtone, notification, and alarm content URIs are read and applied.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No network is used; pool members must resolve to a local download, a picked local file, or a bundled Aura Original before they are applied.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver does not affect pool shuffles; WRITE_SETTINGS and local media availability are the applicable gates.
postureRows.privacySurface: The worker reads the local pool store and download database and applies a local media URI without uploading data.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No network is used; Run now applies the same local pool members as the scheduled job.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver does not affect a manual pool run because it performs no remote request.
postureRows.privacySurface: The worker reads the local pool store and applies a local media URI without uploading data.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No network is used; profiles contain persisted local sound URIs and clock windows.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver does not affect time-based local sound profile application.
postureRows.privacySurface: Profile definitions and applied sound URIs remain local to Aura and Android system settings.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: No scheduler network constraint is declared because packs may contain local URIs; a user-selected remote locator can use the active metered network during apply.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Local pack slots are unaffected; remote locators inherit platform Data Saver behavior and the next periodic run can recover after connectivity returns.
postureRows.privacySurface: The worker reads the local pack definition; only a user-selected remote wallpaper locator can contact its original host.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: Metered network is currently allowed for lightweight Open-Meteo refreshes.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Settings diagnostics and support bundles read ConnectivityManager metered/Data Saver status and show action hints for restricted background data plus OEM battery recovery guidance.
postureRows.privacySurface: Weather endpoint and coarse rounded location data use are covered by network endpoint and Data safety rows.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: Metered network is blocked for the bundled sound pack download.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Unmetered WorkManager constraint is the current Data Saver-safe posture for this larger first-run transfer; diagnostics add OEM battery recovery guidance when it stays queued.
postureRows.privacySurface: Bundled sound provenance and native/dependency packets cover release evidence; no user data is uploaded.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: Metered network is allowed for explicit user/automation-triggered one-shot rotations.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Settings diagnostics and support bundles read ConnectivityManager metered/Data Saver status and show action hints for restricted background data plus OEM battery recovery guidance; direct expedited quota receipt remains future OS evidence.
postureRows.privacySurface: Provider fetches inherit the selected wallpaper source's network/Data safety rows.

postureRows.meteredPolicy: Allowed: the person started the batch, and each provider caps how many items one action can fetch.
postureRows.dataSaverPolicy: Data Saver doesn't hold back a batch the person started in the foreground; each item goes through DownloadManager's size caps.
postureRows.privacySurface: Fetches the favorites' public image URLs from their providers; nothing about the person is uploaded.
